title: Bali Honeymoon Getaway | Romantic Offshore Retreat
highlights: Soak up Bali’s pristine beaches, explore lush rice terraces, and dive into its vibrant temples for a varied experience.
Marvel at Uluwatu Temple’s dramatic clifftop setting, where ancient rituals and panoramic ocean views create a breathtaking experience.
Enjoy a romantic candlelight dinner with your partner at Jimbaran Beach, while the sun sets over the serene waves.
Explore thrilling water activities at Tanjung Benoa Beach, and dive into the crystal-clear waters of Bali’s vibrant coastline.
overview:
About the destination:
Experience the allure of Bali, a tropical haven renowned for its stunning beaches, lush rice terraces, and vibrant culture. Relax on the golden sands of Kuta and Seminyak, indulge in thrilling water sports, or explore the island's spiritual heart by visiting iconic temples like Tanah Lot and Uluwatu. Immerse yourself in the local lifestyle, savour delicious cuisine, and create unforgettable memories in this paradise island. From bustling markets to world-class dining, these coastal destinations offer something for everyone.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered as a valid address proof.

Thrillophilia reserves the right to rearrange the itinerary due to any kind of disturbance that occurred (i.e weather condition, political condition or any others) without changing the total number of days and without compromising any service.
Any breakage or damage of any items at the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Visa assistance will be provided however, charges have to be borne by the visitors.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
The hotels are subject to availability. In case they are not available, the travellers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Images are only for representation purposes.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Kuta Airport, get driven to your hotel. Check in and spend your time at leisure. You can visit Ground Zero Monument, a tribute to the victims of the 2002 Bali bombings, or visit the Pura Petitenget Temple, an ancient Balinese temple renowned for its intricate architecture. You can also wander through the Kuta Night Market, where vibrant stalls offer a variety of local crafts, and delicious street food. Afterward, return to your hotel.

days.title: Full Day Temple Tour with Monkey Forest
days.desc: Today, get driven to explore Bali's iconic temples. Start with Taman Ayun Temple, celebrated for its intricate carvings and serene garden setting. Next, visit Tanah Lot Temple, renowned for its stunning sea views and scenic location on a volcanic rock formation. Then, explore Uluwatu Temple on a dramatic cliff, where you can optionally watch the Kecak and Fire Dance. Finally, enjoy playful monkeys at Alas Kedaton Monkey Forest before getting transferred to your hotel.

days.title: Water Sports and Sunset Dinner Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, get transferred to Tanjung Benoa Beach for an action-packed day of water sports, including thrilling banana boat rides, jet skiing, and parasailing (additional costs). After enjoying these exciting activities, board a scenic cruise at Benoa Harbor for a delicious buffet dinner. While you dine, be entertained by vibrant dance performances showcasing local culture. Conclude the day with a transfer back to your hotel for a comfortable and restful overnight stay.

days.title: Traditional Massage Experience | Transfer to Seminyak | Leisure Day
days.desc: Post check out, board your transfer to Seminyak. En route, visit a spa studio for a relaxing session. Enjoy a refreshing foot soak, a body scrub, and a soothing massage. Continue your journey to Seminyak, check into your hotel and spend the rest of the day exploring the city. You can stroll at Echo Beach, known for its stunning black sand. Or, visit Santo Mikael Church, and the Oberoi Flea Market. Afterward, return to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day | Candlelight Dinner Experience
days.desc: Today, spend some time exploring sites at your leisure. You can visit Nyaman Gallery, known for its contemporary art, and Biasa Art Space, featuring local artistic creations. You can also discover Double Six Beach, famous for its lively atmosphere and beautiful sunsets. In the evening, get driven to Jimbaran Beach for a romantic candlelit dinner with your partner. Conclude your day with a transfer back to your hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.
